title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 6b06d98a817f… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 6b06d98a817f5f25009af8fdef6a077a750259519fbac9b02176dcf497be0a8e was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-14. This file was detected seven times during attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) originating from attacker infrastructure in the Netherlands. The file hash corresponds to a malicious payload that could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to check their environments and security tools for this hash to detect potential compromise.
